datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Kenya to collect Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data. The IPC classifications were spatially mapped and compiled into geographic datasets for January, March, and April 2022 medium-term projections, representing food insecurity impact assessments across different scenarios.
